title: Threshold Advisor for Canary Decisioning and Automated Reverts
creator: Ava Patel
description: Implement a "Threshold Advisor" service and integration for canary and A/B rollouts that recommends and enforces automated rollback triggers based on a composite of SLO signals (latency, error rate, token cost, throughput). This ticket covers the MVP pipeline: historical metric analysis, candidate threshold generation per-metric and per-customer cohort, realtime composite scoring for staged rollouts, and conservative enforcement rules (minimum sample windows, hysteresis, and cooldowns). The goal is to reduce noisy or premature rollbacks while catching real regressions during early traffic exposure. This is aimed at Dedicated and Hosted customers and should be plumbed into the Rollout Orchestrator and Console alerting UI.
background: We currently have manual SLO thresholds configured in the rollout config and several ad-hoc autotuning experiments. Past incidents show both missed regressions due to thresholds set too loose and unnecessary rollbacks caused by short-lived spikes. Existing related work includes ENG-4872 and ENG-9125 but those focus on rollback heuristics and auto-rollback tuning with different signal aggregation. This ticket focuses on a data-driven advisor that outputs conservative, per-rollout thresholds and provides confidence bands, explainability, and a simulated false-positive estimate before being applied.
goals: Provide an offline threshold recommendation engine that ingests 90d of metric history and proposes P99 latency, error-rate, token-cost-per-request and throughput baselines with confidence intervals
Expose a realtime composite score computed during canaries combining normalized signals and weightings into a single decision metric
Implement a conservative enforcement policy with minimum sample size, sliding window, hysteresis and automatic cooldowns to avoid flapping
Add Console UI hooks to preview recommended thresholds, simulation results, and accept/reject recommendations
Log all advisor recommendations and decision events for audit and postmortem analysis
acceptance_criteria: Advisor service produces recommendations for a given customer and model variant with a structured explanation string
Rollout Orchestrator accepts advisor recommendations via API and can run a dry-run simulation of detect/rollback decisions against historical traffic
Automated revert triggers use composite score and only trigger when sample window >= configured minimum and composite score crosses a tunable threshold for at least N consecutive windows
Console shows recommended thresholds, simulation FP/FN estimates, and an accept button that persists chosen thresholds to the rollout config
Unit/integration tests for advisor algos and a canary simulation harness with synthetic traffic scenarios exist in the repo
tasks: Spec: write Confluence doc describing algorithm, inputs, outputs, and UI interactions - https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ML/Threshold+Advisor+Spec
Data prep: ETL job to produce per-customer, per-model metric distributions for 90d - analytics/etl PR GH: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4212
Algorithm: implement baseline estimator (exponential moving quantiles) + Bayesian credible intervals for P99 latency and token cost
Composite scoring: normalize signals, allow weight overrides in rollout config, compute rolling z-scores and aggregate using a robust median-of-means
API: add /advisor/v1/recommend endpoint and /advisor/v1/simulate for dry-runs
Orchestrator integration: consume chosen thresholds and enforce using existing rollback actuator with additional hysteresis layer
Console: add preview panel with recommended thresholds and simulation results (PM and Design review required)
Telemetry: add audit events for recommendations and decision signals to internal S3 bucket and datadog dashboard
E2E: run canary simulations across worst-case traffic shapes (spikes, slow drift, bursty errors) and record FP/FN rates
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Overfitting thresholds to recent anomalies. Mitigation: use robust estimators and minimum 90d lookback with outlier trimming
Risk: False positives causing unnecessary rollbacks. Mitigation: require multi-window confirmation, min-sample-size, and conservative default weights (latency/error > cost)
Risk: Performance cost of realtime composite scoring. Mitigation: compute incremental aggregates and cache per-rollout state in Redis; benchmark targets: <10ms extra p99 decision latency
Risk: Customer confusion when advisor suggests thresholds. Mitigation: provide clear explainability strings and a simulation FP/FN estimate in Console
